{{Quote|Where are our fighters? Why they do nothing?''"<br />"''You have brought them back, captain.|[[Daultay Dofine/Legends|Daultay Dofine]] and the Neimoidian navigator|<ref name="CoD" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] who served as a [[Navigator/Legends|navigator]] for [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Daultay Dofine/Legends|Daultay Dofine]] on the bridge of the ''[[Revenue]]'', a [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Lucrehulk-class LH-3210 cargo freighter/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class LH-3210 cargo freighter]].<ref name="CoD" /> In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' to [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].</ref> the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Arwen Cohl]] and his crew infiltrated the ship. The navigator, Dofine, and the rest of the crew then escaped to the [[Acquisitor (Lucrehulk-class battleship)|''Acquisitor'']], which arrived on the [[Dorvalla system/Legends|Dorvalla system]] as reinforcement.<ref name="CoD" />
